exercise.instruction: There are mistakes in some of these sentences. Correct the sentences where necessary. Write 'OK' if the sentence is already correct.

items.prompt: The building was total destroyed in the fire.
I didn't like the book. It was such a stupid story.
The city is very polluted. It's the more polluted place I've ever been to.
answers: It's the most polluted place I've ever been to.

items.prompt: I was disappointing that I didn't get the job. I was well-qualified and the interview went well.
answers: I was disappointed that I didn't get the job.

items.prompt: It's warm today, but there's quite a strong wind.
Joe works hardly, but he doesn't get paid very much.
answers: Joe works hard, but he doesn't get paid very much.

items.prompt: The company's offices are in a modern large building.
answers: The company's offices are in a large modern building.

items.prompt: Dan is a very fast runner. I wish I could run as fast as him.
I missed the three last days of the course because I was ill.
answers: I missed the last three days of the course because I was ill.

items.prompt: You don't look happy. What's the matter?
The weather has been unusual cold for the time of the year.
answers: The weather has been unusually cold for the time of the year.

items.prompt: The water in the pool was too dirty to swim in it.
answers: The water in the pool was too dirty to swim in.

items.prompt: I got impatient because we had to wait so long time.
answers: I got impatient because we had to wait such a long time.
I got impatient because we had to wait so long.

items.prompt: Is this box big enough or do you need a bigger one?
This morning I got up more early than usual.
answers: This morning I got up earlier than usual.
